comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors, 1-1.5 points below measured, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/repo_guards/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-09-23 WITH all 10 declared siblings checked out and c8 --all: 96.49 lines/statements, 84.18 branches, 94.98 functions over 6690 passing unit tests. The only exclusion is the process entrypoint src/api.js: subprocess tests execute it directly, while collecting its full V8 process coverage delays exit past their explicit venue-speed ceiling.
